description: This Java source file defines an Android IntentService named BigPictureSocialIntentService, which handles asynchronously updating social app notifications that utilize BigPictureStyle. It processes comment actions from notifications, updates notifications dynamically, and recreates notifications if the app process is killed. The class interacts with notification builders, remote input for user responses, and uses the NotificationCompat API to build and modify notifications.

classes.name: BigPictureSocialIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that manages updating and handling user comments for a BigPictureStyle notification in a social app context.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Overrides IntentService method to process incoming intents, specifically handling comment actions.

methods.name: handleActionComment
methods.description: Processes a user comment, updates the notification with the new comment, and pushes the updated notification.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Extracts the comment text from the intent via RemoteInput.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithBigPictureStyle
methods.description: Recreates the notification builder with the current BigPictureStyle notification data, used if the app process is killed.
